symptom: `diag session-report` counted a Bash read that exited 0 as a failure — `sed -n … SKILL.md` printing 'ERROR - Client: …', `mxcli syntax page action` printing 'ERROR: `Action: OPEN LINK` …' — and the next call as a retry.
cause: detectFailure applied the errorLine heuristic (meant for a command whose exit a pipe hides) to every Bash result, so text a file or help page quotes read as an error.
fix: The line heuristic is skipped when every segment of the command is orientation (ParseBash + segmentCategory); an empty command is not taken as a read. is_error still fails any call, and a validation behind a pipe or a mixed chain still fails on its error line.
insight: The report already classified each segment; the failure rule just never asked. On this session's own transcript the count fell from 36 to 35 failures.
test: cmd/mxcli/sessionreport/read_not_failure_2525_test.go (two reported reads and a grep pipe; check|tail and a mixed chain as controls; is_error control)
